annotation.title_clean: HOUSE LAUNCHES BIPARTISAN TASK FORCE ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
annotation.title_en: House Launches Bipartisan Task Force on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Rep. Ted Lieu, U.S. House of Representatives
annotation.summary_en: Press release of 20 February 2024 announcing a bipartisan U.S. House Task Force on AI, chaired by Jay Obernolte and Ted Lieu. It will produce a report with guiding principles and policy proposals, balancing American AI leadership and innovation with appropriate guardrails. Lists the 24 members.
key_provisions_or_claims: Speaker Johnson and Leader Jeffries establish a bipartisan House Task Force on AI with 12 appointees each.
Chair Obernolte and Co-Chair Lieu lead it.
Task Force will produce a comprehensive report with guiding principles, recommendations and bipartisan policy proposals.
Goal: maintain US AI leadership while considering guardrails against current and emerging threats.
